lastCompletedStory.title: Add worker-container orchestration module (build + run one long-lived container) with credential env threading

nextStoryContext: US-001 (B-1 substrate) is complete. The worker-container module is inert: loop.ts and plan-runner.ts do NOT import it. US-002 is the JSON->argv parity assertion story (verify that buildDockerRunArgv mirrors every devcontainer.json field exactly). The injectable ContainerSpawnFn seam follows the same DockerProbe pattern from preflight-container.ts. The workspace bind-mount source is the workspaceFolder parameter (callers pass the real cwd). Name-only -e token threading confirmed by Docker docs: if the host env var is unset, the container var is also unset (not an error).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Name-only -e VARNAME form confirmed: inherits from host env; unset host var = unset container var. Implementation is correct.
